memory_method: Recursive sys.getsizeof with a shared visited set, including immutable buffer owners and owned NumPy payloads; dataclass views are traversed through stored fields without materializing external records. Graph/base totals exclude measurements/hills/display/extra policies/caches and allocator/interpreter overhead. Attribution rows depend on traversal order. PathData totals cover the loaded smaller dataset before interaction caches are populated.
timing_method: Separate standalone processes, reference first then packed. Five bounded-search and uncached static-tile samples per case; planner cases are single samples. Not interleaved across versions or controlled for system activity. No live API/browser check. Peak RSS includes loading and benchmark work, not retained memory.
